method: Each official amazon.com listing named below was fetched live in this session and read in the sections that carry the values: the product-information block (Features & Specs, Measurements, Materials & Care), the Item details block, the Purchase options and add-ons table, and the About this item bullets. Every value is quoted as the listing printed it. A field this pass did not reach is recorded as 'not reached in this pass' rather than copied from the register, so the next session knows exactly what is still unchecked.
reading_note: Chunk indices are fetch-dependent: Amazon interleaves sponsored-ad modules into the page, so the same listing splits into different chunks on different fetches. The section name is the stable citation; the chunk number is not. See FLG-052.

read: §1: "The links must properly use the special 'tagged' link formats we provide and comply with this Agreement ('Special Links')."
§4: "We do not make any representation, warranty, or covenant regarding the amount of traffic or commission income you can expect at any time in connection with the Associates Program."
§5: "You must clearly and prominently state the following ... 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.'"
§6: a violation of Section 5 is a material breach.
policy_sources.result: The site's disclosure sentence is the §5 wording, and the site states no traffic or commission expectation.

read: Participation Requirements §2(a): "Special Links must use the Associates ID we have assigned to you."

Participation Requirements §2(b): "All Special Links must be accessed directly from your Site ... you must include your Associates ID or 'tag' ... as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site."

Participation Requirements §2(b): "your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API ..."
Participation Requirements §2(b): "You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product."
Commission Income Statement §1(a): a qualifying purchase occurs when "a customer clicks through a Special Link on your Site to an Amazon Site".
policy_sources.result: The site shows no price or availability, carries the tag on every product link, and states no claim the listing does not print.

read: "rel='sponsored' - Mark links that are advertisements or paid placements (commonly called paid links) with the sponsored value."
"Multiple values - You may specify multiple rel values as a space- or comma-separated list."
policy_sources.result: Every product listing link on the site carries rel="sponsored nofollow"; policy and government citations do not.

read: "ASIN" stands for "Amazon Standard Identification Number." It's a unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to every product listed in the Amazon store.
"URL method: Look at the URL for a product detail page in the Amazon store. The ASIN appears after '/dp/'."
policy_sources.result: The five observed ASINs are 10-character codes, and the supplied link tokens are 9 characters, so the tokens are short-link codes and not ASINs (FLG-014).

read: "if there's a connection between an endorser and the marketer that a significant minority of consumers wouldn't expect and it would affect how they evaluate the endorsement, that connection should be disclosed clearly and conspicuously"
The Guides were revised in 2023, including a new definition of "clearly and conspicuously".
policy_sources.result: The site's disclosure strip sits under the masthead on every page, above the main content, and repeats in the footer.

P-01 model / part number, P-02 Item details and Features & Specs blocks, P-02 accessory counts - not reached in this pass; the published values stand on the earlier readings.
Hands-on behaviour of any product: nothing here was tested, cooked with, or measured.

new_observations_for_review.summary: P-05 is a variation family (1-4 probes) behind one ASIN; the published figures are the 3-probe variant.
Chunk numbers in the provenance strings are fetch-dependent; the section name is the stable citation.
P-01, P-03 and P-04 print a second, vaguer warranty sentence in the Warranty & Support block.
The policy documents carry their own revision dates, now recorded next to the date they were read.
Resolved with an official source: a 9-character token cannot be a 10-character ASIN.
